title: centaurium scilloides var. portense
intro: Centaurium scilloides var. portense, commonly known as Mountain centaury or Mountain bluet, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Centaurium scilloides var. portense include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
